_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Religious Education 2046 Syllabus, Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 10, Units 1-7 (Topics 10.1-10.7), Part One: Themes from the Gospels (based on the Gospel of Luke). Cross-referenced against a parallel provincial Religious Education teaching-notes booklet covering the same unit structure, prepared for provincial use with no usage restriction; per standing instruction, no individual name is cited from either source, credit given only to CDC / Ministry of Education. Topic, sub-topic and Specific Outcome statements only; the 'Content' column (Bible passage references, knowledge points, skills, values) is omitted, consistent with the approach used for the other 2013 OBC subjects in this app, since it text-extracts unreliably from the source's multi-column table and is extremely dense with scripture citations. This document's outcome numbering codes are unreliable throughout — worse than the other OBC syllabi processed so far, with codes frequently drifting, duplicating or missing a digit (e.g. an outcome under a 10.1.x sub-topic printed as plain '10.1.1' with no fourth part, or as '0.1.5.1' missing its leading digit). Rather than catalogue each individual instance, every sub-topic and outcome below was reconstructed by position — matching each outcome to the sub-topic heading it appears directly under in the source table, in the table's own reading order — and given clean sequential numbering (Topic.SubTopic.Outcome) rather than reproducing the unreliable printed codes. Sub-topic names are reproduced as printed (often without their own topic-prefixed numbering in the source). The syllabus organizes content by Grade only, not by Term in this file (a suggested termly Scheme of Work exists in the syllabus introduction assigning Units to terms, which could inform term-splitting in a future revision), so all of Grade 10 is modeled as a single term here. UPDATE (2026-08-30): term-split and references added, sourced from a real Ministry-approved Grade 10-12 RE 2046 common scheme of work (Drive folder shared by the user 2026-08-30). The source document's own header contained a real individual's name, phone number, and unrelated promotional text — none of that was carried over; only the term/week/topic structure and the References column's actual content ('RE Syllabus 2046; Grade 10 Pupil's Book; RE Teacher's Book; Good News Bible', repeated near-verbatim for every real row in the source) were used. The source's own printed week numbers were internally inconsistent between terms (a stray '12' reappearing at the start of Term 2, a probable typo printed as '45') — rather than reproduce that unreliable numbering, week numbers were normalized to restart at 1 within each term (matching this app's own per-term week semantics elsewhere) while preserving the source's real topic-to-term and topic-to-week groupings wherever those were unambiguous.
